text: {"lessons":["A sharp loss in one holding can materially hurt the account, so I should keep position sizes diversified and avoid letting any single stock dominate risk.","Selling Stock A after a steep decline may have been driven by loss aversion; I should base future trades on fundamentals, valuation, and risk limits rather than the pain of being down versus my cost.","My infrequent trading avoids impulsive reactions, but I should still review the portfolio periodically and rebalance when the investment case or target allocation changes."]}
